headline: GREEN: HRV 67 (from 42), RHR 49, TSB +3. Run, not bike, if the knee test is clean. Take 55min, not 50
summary: HRV 67 (42 yesterday, 7-day avg 59), RHR 49 (baseline 46, still +3), sleep 6.4h score 81 despite the 22:45 landing. CTL 47.5, ATL 44.7, TSB +3. Rebound came a day earlier than expected: the Monday dip was dehydration plus travel, not race damage. RHR +3 says recovery is not complete, so the cap stays at 145bpm and no strides today. The bike swap planned yesterday is off unless the knee test or quads say otherwise.
flags: Today: knee test first (10 single-leg squats left + 2 flights down). Clean = run 55min at 135-145bpm, cadence 170+. Pain or quads still sore on stairs = 50min hotel bike 120-135bpm.
Pushing +10%: 50 to 55min, ~50 load vs 45 planned. Recovery week, so no more than that. The real upside is Saturday.
Wed: 50min + 6x20s strides stays as planned. HRV over 60 and knee clean Tue-Wed = strides at full turnover, not cautious.
Sat 10 Oct: 2h30 / ~650m D+ unlocked if HRV over 62 on Thu (late return) or Fri. Today's 67 points that way.
CTL 47.5 vs 55 planning number with 3 build weeks left (Wk5 545, Wk6 525, Wk7 515). The recovery-week dip is planned; Wk5 has to land in full, no trimming in Barcelona.
Travel pattern holds: HRV dips after every flight day, rebounds in 24-36h when you drink. Same 2.5L rule for the Thu late return.
suggestedChange: Today 50 to 55min at the same 135-145bpm cap if knee test clean (load ~50 vs 45).
